resources.string: Experimental, and against Spotify’s terms

This source plays Spotify audio outside Spotify’s own apps. Spotify can suspend an account used this way. Use a separate, throwaway account here, never the one your library and playlists live on. The streaming account registers a device called Natune Player and reports what it plays.

Resolve method
Web player (AAC 128, Widevine)
Desktop (Ogg Vorbis or FLAC)
About the methods
The web player method needs Widevine on this device. The desktop method decrypts on the device and falls back to the web player method when it cannot resolve a track.
